title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, dashboard panels, and alert tuning
author: Priya Singh
description: Add token-level KV cache metrics and tracing hooks, extend Grafana dashboard panels for token cost/latency breakdowns, and tune PagerDuty/SLO alerts. Motivation: customers and platform teams require finer-grained observability into per-token KV cache behavior to make batching and quantization decisions; recent incidents showed KV cache evictions correlated with spikes in token latency and cost. This PR implements: 1) new runtime metrics emitted at token boundaries: kv_cache_hit, kv_cache_miss, kv_cache_eviction, kv_prefetch_latency_ms, kv_lookup_latency_ms, and token_generation_cost_us. 2) tracing spans for KV path with tags for model, shard, request_id, and token_index. 3) Grafana dashboard updates: new token-kv panels, stacked cost/latency breakdowns by model variant, per-route top token hotspots, and an aggregate cost-per-1000-tokens heatmap. 4) Alert tuning: adjust rate-and-burst thresholds for kv_cache_miss_rate and token_generation_latency P95/P99; add an aggregated SLO burn alert and a soft-warning channel for Engineering triage. 5) Logging: structured context added to runtime logs for easier correlation with traces and dashboards. 6) Tests and migration docs. Checklist: [x] runtime metric instrumentation [x] tracing spans and tags [x] dashboard JSON and variables [x] alerting rules and runbook updates [x] end-to-end smoke tests on staging [x] docs/upgrade notes. Notes: metrics are opt-in per-deployment via observability.enable_token_metrics flag (default false for Dedicated/Private to avoid cardinality increases); feature gate added to config schema. Related: ENG-1723 for rollout plan, SUP-4321 customer incident reference.

Priya Singh: Thanks Ava. Added the feature gate (config/schema.yaml) and guarded tags; included runbook note and added unit test eviction_counter_test in latest push.

Miguel Torres: Alert thresholds LGTM but we should run a one-week canary in staging to capture real traffic before pushing to prod. Also, can we reduce default retention for token-level metrics in hosted to 7d?
Priya Singh: Agreed on canary. Updated alerting CR to include a staging-only ruleset and lowered retention for hosted via infra/helm/values.yaml. Will monitor during canary window (ENG-1723).

Liam O'Connor: Minor nit: dashboard panel labels could be shorter to fit mobile. Suggest truncating 'token_generation_cost_us' to 'tok_cost_us' in panel labels only. Also add a templated variable for deployment tier.
Priya Singh: Updated dashboard panel labels and added deployment_tier variable. Responded to all nits and pushed changes.
merge_details: Merged by Ava Chen via squash merge on 2026-02-20. Merge commit: squash! Commit message consolidated metrics/tracing/dashboard/alerts. Release notes: Adds opt-in token-level KV metrics and tracing spans, new Grafana dashboard panels for token-level cost and latency breakdowns, updated alert rules and runbook for KV miss/eviction incidents, and feature gate to control cardinality. Rollout: enabled in staging for 1 week (ENG-1723) before gradual rollout to hosted; default OFF for Dedicated/Private. Post-merge actions: monitor kv_cache_miss_rate and token_generation_latency SLOs, coordinate with Support for customer impact.
release_notes: Adds opt-in token-level KV metrics, new token-kv Grafana dashboard, tracing spans for KV path, tuned alerts for kv miss and token latency, and runbook updates. Feature gated to avoid cardinality spikes; default disabled for Dedicated/Private.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: token-level metrics increase cardinality and Prometheus storage. Mitigation: feature gate default off for Dedicated/Private, lower retention for hosted token metrics to 7d, and clear runbook to disable if necessary. Canary: staged rollout and 1-week canary in staging. Alerts: soft-warning channel before page to reduce noise.
testing_and_rollout: Unit tests added for counters and guards, e2e smoke tests validated in staging, dashboards validated via grafana-json-validate. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 7 days, monitor, then gradual enable for select hosted clusters, followed by wider rollout. ENG-1723 tracks rollout and metrics to observe.
notes: Cardinality-sensitive tags (request_id/token_index) are not exported to Prometheus by default; they are included in traces only. Customers on Dedicated can opt-in but should be warned about storage implications. Runbook includes immediate mitigation steps (disable feature gate, revert ruleset, reduce retention).
